raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash low-latency decode on GB300 (TP4, DSpark speculative decoding). With the NVIDIA megakernel plugin enabled (`--enable-nvidia-megakernel`), the GPU part of each decode step gets short enough that SGLang's host-side work between graphs (input preparation, verify metadata, accept bookkeeping, KV commits) becomes a large share of the step. This PR moves that work into the existing CUDA graphs, into fewer launches, or off the critical path.

Most changes are behind environment flags that default to off. Two DSpark-only changes are on by default: the draft sampling-param restaging (1) and the draft runner's metadata prep through the glue graph where it applies (2). The two changes that reach beyond DSpark are opt-in: the MoE output-shape fix (3, `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE`) and the CUDA graph fill fast paths (7, `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH`).

## Modifications

One commit per change:

1. **DSpark draft:** restage the draft graph's sampling params only when they change.
2. **DSpark draft runner:** prepare its attention metadata through the glue graph.
3. **MXFP4 trtllm-gen MoE** (`SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE`): pass the finalized output shape on deferred-finalize calls above 32 rows, so decode batches hit the tuned tactic instead of the default tile. Off keeps main's 97-384-row window.
4. **Fused static accept tail** (`SGLANG_DSPARK_FUSED_ACCEPT_TAIL`): the static greedy accept and its bookkeeping in one kernel.
5. **One-launch step inputs** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_PREPARE_INPUTS_ONCE`, `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_MID_FOLD`): the step inputs in one launch; the verify ids come from the draft graph's tail.
6. **Deferred draft context-KV commit** (`SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV`): the static verify's draft context-KV commit moves to the next draft graph.
7. **CUDA graph replay fill fast paths** (`SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH`): skip the padding reset of an unpadded fill; copy one dense integer dtype pair with one foreach launch.
8. **Target verify metadata through the glue graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_VERIFY_METADATA_GLUE`).
9. **Engram history commit and block accept lengths inside the verify graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_POST_FORWARD_CUDA_GRAPH`).
10. **Draft graph metadata on a side stream** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_DRAFT_PREP_FORK`).
11. **Seq lens and bonus relayed from the verify graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_POST_FOLD`).
12. **The deferred context KV projected inside the verify graph**, so that only its stores are deferred.
13. **Simulated bonus:** reads the shared accept length as a stride-0 view. Simulated acceptance only.
14. **The deferred commit's staging in one launch** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_ONE_LAUNCH_COMMIT_STAGE`).
15. **Target verify metadata built beside the draft graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_METADATA_EARLY`; enabled only when the runner's conditions hold, including the metadata glue graph).
16. **A pre-planned verify replay skips its input re-copies** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SKIP_PREFILLED_INPUTS`).
17. **Skip the replay ForwardBatch view** once the metadata glue graph is captured (`SGLANG_OPT_SKIP_GLUED_REPLAY_VIEW`).
18. **Draw the simulated acceptance before the draft launch** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SIM_DRAW_AHEAD`). Simulated acceptance only.
19. **Block-wise rejection sampling for the sampled verify accept** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION`).
20. **A CUDA graph for the static verify's temperature-sampling accept** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH`): the sampling accept, its TP broadcast and the KV / engram commits replay as one graph launch.

## Accuracy Tests

GB300, TP4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, megakernel plugin on, all flags above on, real acceptance (commands under Reproduce below):

| check | all 20 commits on (incl. 19-20) | commits 19-20 off |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K-200 c8, greedy | 196 / 200, accept length 4.26 | 198 / 200, accept length 4.29 |
| GSM8K-200 c8, temperature 1.0 | 198 / 200, accept length 4.17 | 196 / 200, accept length 4.07 |
| needle at ~155K tokens | 26 / 27 | 24 / 27 |

Both commits were confirmed active in the first run (block-wise rejection on sampled verifies, the sampling-accept region captured, 4 / 4 ranks). The needle test varies between 22 and 27 / 27 from run to run on identical code.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GB300, TP4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. AgentX (InferenceX agentic traces), concurrency 1, 3,600 s, synthetic acceptance 3.51 with the stock accept sampling (the simulated-acceptance shortcut is reverted in every arm). All arms run on SGLang main `f0b65907227` with the same image and settings, and are compared on the same 220 requests. TPS/User = 1 / ITL.

| configuration | TPS/User P50 | TPS/User P90 | decode step p50 (> 256K) |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 694.0 | 676.1 | 5.06 ms |
| main + this PR (commits 1-18) | 709.7 (+2.3%) | 694.1 (+2.7%) | 4.95 ms |
| main + megakernel plugin (sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega#18, default slots) | 762.2 (+9.8%) | 717.4 (+6.1%) | 4.57 ms |
| main + this PR (commits 1-18) + plugin (#18, 42 slots) | 952.0 (+37.2%) | 902.2 (+33.4%) | 3.66 ms |
| main + this PR (all 20 commits) + plugin (#18, 42 slots) | 995.7 (+43.5%) | 972.8 (+43.9%) | 3.54 ms |

Rows with this PR were measured with the changes listed above enabled, including `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE=1` and `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH=1` (on by default at measurement time). With the plugin held fixed, this PR adds +30.6% P50 / +35.6% P90 (rows 3 and 5). Rows 4 and 5 also enable three opt-in plugin slots. Without the plugin, the host work this PR removes is hidden behind the longer GPU step, so the PR alone moves little. Rows 1-3 repeat on a second cluster within 0.3% at P50.

Known interaction: with `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1` and `NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1` set in the environment, the deferred context-KV commit (`SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV`) adds a 45-105 ms stall before the last streamed token of requests above 256K tokens (87 / 209 such requests in one AgentX run). The stall grows with context length. With both NCCL variables at 0, no request stalls (0 / 209) and P90 rises 4.5%. The table above was measured without these variables.

### Reproduce

**Code and setup.** One GB300 node (4 GPUs), image `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261020-ab580b2e`, model `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` (revision `df42c109f1d`). Every tree is on `main` at `f0b65907227` with #45421 reverted (`git revert 7d9bc104932`): under `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN` that commit skips the accept sampling on CUDA.

| tree | rows |
|---|---|
| `f0b65907227` + the revert | Speed 1 and 3 |
| commits 1-18 on the same base (YAMY1234/sglang `98891329ced`) | Speed 2 and 4 |
| all 20 commits on the same base (YAMY1234/sglang `227d2a4934e`) | Speed 5, Accuracy |

The current head carries the same commits on a newer main plus review fixes. On it, also set `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE=1` and `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH=1` (commits 3 and 7 had no switch when measured). Plugin for Speed 3-5 and Accuracy: sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega `547bf4486e9`, installed over the image's copy with `pip install --no-deps -e .`; it stays inactive without `--enable-nvidia-megakernel`.

**Server (Speed Tests).**

export SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL=1
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.51 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token
export SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1 SGLANG_DSV41_REASONING_EFFORT=high SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900
# rows 2, 4 and 5: this PR's switches
export SGLANG_DSPARK_FUSED_ACCEPT_TAIL=1 SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_PREPARE_INPUTS_ONCE=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_MID_FOLD=1 \

# row 5 also
export SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH=1
# rows 4 and 5: the plugin's 39 default slots + target_lm_head, hop_b_quad_trigger, lm_head_pinned_tactic

TPS/User P50 / P90 = 1 / p50 and 1 / p90 of the per-request ITL in `profile_export.jsonl` (profiling phase, failed requests dropped). Every row is read on the same 220 requests, matched by conversation and turn; over each whole run (391-492 requests) the values are within 0.8% of the table. Decode step p50 (> 256K) comes from TP0's `Decode batch` lines with one running request: accept length / gen throughput, lines above 262,144 tokens.

**Accuracy Tests.** Tree `227d2a4934e`, the plugin with the 42 slots above, real acceptance (no `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_*`), the server args above with `--max-running-requests 256`. The two columns differ only in `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION` and `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH` (1 vs 0). - GSM8K-200: the first 200 `openai/gsm8k` (main) test questions, 5-shot from the first five train examples, DeepSeek-V4.1 chat format with thinking off, sent to `/generate` with `max_new_tokens` 512 and 8 requests in flight, temperature 0.0 or 1.0. 1. **Block-wise rejection sampling for the sampled verify accept** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION`, default off).
2. **A CUDA graph for the static verify's temperature-sampling accept** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH`, default off). The sampling accept, its TP broadcast and the KV / engram commits replay as one graph launch instead of about 25 eager kernels.

AgentX c1, GB300 TP4, SGLang main `f0b65907227` with the megakernel plugin (sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega#18, 42 slots), same image and settings in every arm, compared on the same 220 requests, TPS/User P50 / P90:

| configuration | P50 | P90 |
|---|---|---|
| main | 694.0 | 676.1 |
| main + this PR without the two commits | 952.0 (+37.2%) | 902.2 (+33.4%) |
| main + this PR with the two commits enabled | 995.7 (+43.5%) | 972.8 (+43.9%) |

The two commits add +4.6% P50 / +7.8% P90 on top of the rest of the PR. CPU tests and GPU kernel tests pass on both commits (GPU: 168 / 168).

Note: on a second cluster, long-context requests showed an extra 45-105 ms stall before the last streamed token; it follows that cluster's NCCL cuMem / MNNVL settings, not these commits, and the numbers above are from the cluster without it.

Isolated A/B of the two changes in this PR that reach beyond DSpark. Both are now opt-in: `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE` and `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH`, default off.

**Setup**
- Base: SGLang main `eb91a41f380`, GB300 TP4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
- Megakernel plugin off, so the stock MoE and graph paths are exercised.
- Static ISL 8K / OSL 1K.

Both runs had 0 server errors.

[by Claude Code] This review is done by agents. Please feel free to disagree if they do not make sense.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: style | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

The Accuracy Tests and Speed Tests sections report results but give no commands, so others cannot rerun them. "All flags above on" does not list the env vars and values used, and the DSpark speculative arguments and megakernel plugin settings are not shown. The isolated A/B and DEP2 comments have the same gap.

**Fix**

For each table, add the exact server launch command (model path, TP, DSpark draft and speculative arguments, every env var with its value, and the plugin setup), plus the GSM8K, needle, and AgentX benchmark commands with their settings.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: Medium**

**Issue**

`atexit.register(self._log_draft_glue, ...)` holds a strong reference to this runner until the process exits. The draft glue is on by default for the DSpark draft runner, so that runner, its CUDA graphs and its buffers can never be freed.

**Example**

A weight update with `recapture_cuda_graph=True` calls `ModelRunner.recapture_decode_cuda_graph`, which drops the old runner and captures a new one. The old runner stays alive through the atexit entry, so each recapture keeps another set of graphs in GPU memory and adds another shutdown log.

**Fix**

Remove the atexit hook; `_maybe_log_draft_glue` already logs the counts every 1000 steps. If the shutdown line is needed, register through a `weakref.WeakMethod`.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: style | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

`take` reads the staged inputs with `getattr(forward_batch, name)`. SGLang does not allow `getattr` here. The field names come from the `STAGED_SLOTS` strings, so type checks and grep cannot see which `ForwardBatch` fields this compares.

**Fix**

Store the four sources as named fields, for example a `msgspec.Struct` with `positions`, `out_cache_loc`, `req_pool_indices` and `seq_lens`, and compare `forward_batch.positions` and the others directly. The new tests repeat the pattern (`test_dspark_accept_tail.py:196`, `test_dspark_sampling_accept_graph.py:186` and `:208`); `msgspec.structs.asdict(...)` can replace those calls.

+(SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_METADATA_EARLY).

+The verify inputs the metadata reads (positions, write locations, seq lens and
+req pool indices) are final once the decode head has run. ``stage``, which the host
+issues right after it launches the draft graph, copies them into the verify graph's
+buffers and replays the runner's captured metadata glue graph on a side stream that
+waits only for the head, so the GPU runs it beside the draft; the verify replay
+orders itself after that stream (``take``). Issued after the draft launch, the stage
+replaces the fill and glue replay the host would otherwise run before the verify,
+instead of adding host time before the draft.
+
+Contract:
+
+- The side stream first waits for the head's event, recorded on the current stream
+  after the previous verify replay, which has therefore finished reading the buffers
+  it rewrites.
+- The staged slots are private to the verify runner (never shared through the
+  process-wide input-buffer pool), so the draft graph neither reads nor writes
+  them; the glue graph writes only the verify backend's metadata.
+- ``take`` accepts the staged work only for the same glue key and the very same
+  source views; otherwise the current stream still waits for the side stream and
+  the runner refills and re-runs the glue graph itself.
+- Every staged record ends in a wait (``take`` or ``discard``) on the current
+  stream before anyone else refills the buffers.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_buffer_registry import (
+    CudaGraphBufferRegistry,
+    same_tensor_view,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.metadata_glue_graph import MetadataGlueGraph
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# input_ids is not staged: the draft graph may write it in place (mid fold).
+STAGED_SLOTS = frozenset({"positions", "out_cache_loc", "req_pool_indices", "seq_lens"})
+
+
+class _StagedVerifyInputs(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    key: Any
+    sources: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]
+
+
+class EarlyVerifyMetadata:
+    def __init__(self, *, device, log_every: int) -> None:
+        self._stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device)
+        self._done = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self._staged: Optional[_StagedVerifyInputs] = None
+        self._log_every = log_every
+        self.staged_ct = 0
+        self.taken_ct = 0
+        self.rejected_ct = 0
+        # Per attention variant: [replays that took the staged metadata, replays].
+        self.variant_cts: Dict[Any, list] = {}
+
+    def stage(
+        self,
+        *,
+        glue: MetadataGlueGraph,
+        key,
+        registry: CudaGraphBufferRegistry,
+        sources: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+        after: torch.cuda.Event,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.discard()
+        self._stream.wait_event(after)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self._stream):
+            registry.copy_slots(sources)
+            glue.replay(key)
+            self._done.record()
+        for src in sources.values():
+            src.record_stream(self._stream)
+        self._staged = _StagedVerifyInputs(key=key, sources=sources)
+        self.staged_ct += 1
+        if self.staged_ct == 1 or self.staged_ct % self._log_every == 0:
+            logger.debug(
+                "Target verify metadata staged on the side stream: %d staged, "
+                "%d taken, %d rejected.",
+                self.staged_ct,
+                self.taken_ct,
+                self.rejected_ct,
+            )
+
+    def take(self, *, key, forward_batch) -> bool:
+        """True when this replay's inputs are the staged ones: the fill skips
+        ``STAGED_SLOTS`` and the glue graph already ran for ``key``."""
+        staged = self._staged
+        if staged is None:

detail.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash low-latency decode on GB300 (TP4, DSpark speculative decoding). With the NVIDIA megakernel plugin enabled (`--enable-nvidia-megakernel`), the GPU part of each decode step gets short enough that SGLang's host-side work between graphs (input preparation, verify metadata, accept bookkeeping, KV commits) becomes a large share of the step. This PR moves that work into the existing CUDA graphs, into fewer launches, or off the critical path.

Most changes are behind environment flags that default to off. Two DSpark-only changes are on by default: the draft sampling-param restaging (1) and the draft runner's metadata prep through the glue graph where it applies (2). The two changes that reach beyond DSpark are opt-in: the MoE output-shape fix (3, `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE`) and the CUDA graph fill fast paths (7, `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH`).

## Modifications

One commit per change:

1. **DSpark draft:** restage the draft graph's sampling params only when they change.
2. **DSpark draft runner:** prepare its attention metadata through the glue graph.
3. **MXFP4 trtllm-gen MoE** (`SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE`): pass the finalized output shape on deferred-finalize calls above 32 rows, so decode batches hit the tuned tactic instead of the default tile. Off keeps main's 97-384-row window.
4. **Fused static accept tail** (`SGLANG_DSPARK_FUSED_ACCEPT_TAIL`): the static greedy accept and its bookkeeping in one kernel.
5. **One-launch step inputs** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_PREPARE_INPUTS_ONCE`, `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_MID_FOLD`): the step inputs in one launch; the verify ids come from the draft graph's tail.
6. **Deferred draft context-KV commit** (`SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV`): the static verify's draft context-KV commit moves to the next draft graph.
7. **CUDA graph replay fill fast paths** (`SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH`): skip the padding reset of an unpadded fill; copy one dense integer dtype pair with one foreach launch.
8. **Target verify metadata through the glue graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_VERIFY_METADATA_GLUE`).
9. **Engram history commit and block accept lengths inside the verify graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_POST_FORWARD_CUDA_GRAPH`).
10. **Draft graph metadata on a side stream** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_DRAFT_PREP_FORK`).
11. **Seq lens and bonus relayed from the verify graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_POST_FOLD`).
12. **The deferred context KV projected inside the verify graph**, so that only its stores are deferred.
13. **Simulated bonus:** reads the shared accept length as a stride-0 view. Simulated acceptance only.
14. **The deferred commit's staging in one launch** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_ONE_LAUNCH_COMMIT_STAGE`).
15. **Target verify metadata built beside the draft graph** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_METADATA_EARLY`; enabled only when the runner's conditions hold, including the metadata glue graph).
16. **A pre-planned verify replay skips its input re-copies** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SKIP_PREFILLED_INPUTS`).
17. **Skip the replay ForwardBatch view** once the metadata glue graph is captured (`SGLANG_OPT_SKIP_GLUED_REPLAY_VIEW`).
18. **Draw the simulated acceptance before the draft launch** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SIM_DRAW_AHEAD`). Simulated acceptance only.
19. **Block-wise rejection sampling for the sampled verify accept** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION`).
20. **A CUDA graph for the static verify's temperature-sampling accept** (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH`): the sampling accept, its TP broadcast and the KV / engram commits replay as one graph launch.

## Accuracy Tests

GB300, TP4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, megakernel plugin on, all flags above on, real acceptance (commands under Reproduce below):

| check | all 20 commits on (incl. 19-20) | commits 19-20 off |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K-200 c8, greedy | 196 / 200, accept length 4.26 | 198 / 200, accept length 4.29 |
| GSM8K-200 c8, temperature 1.0 | 198 / 200, accept length 4.17 | 196 / 200, accept length 4.07 |
| needle at ~155K tokens | 26 / 27 | 24 / 27 |

Both commits were confirmed active in the first run (block-wise rejection on sampled verifies, the sampling-accept region captured, 4 / 4 ranks). The needle test varies between 22 and 27 / 27 from run to run on identical code.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GB300, TP4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. AgentX (InferenceX agentic traces), concurrency 1, 3,600 s, synthetic acceptance 3.51 with the stock accept sampling (the simulated-acceptance shortcut is reverted in every arm). All arms run on SGLang main `f0b65907227` with the same image and settings, and are compared on the same 220 requests. TPS/User = 1 / ITL.

| configuration | TPS/User P50 | TPS/User P90 | decode step p50 (> 256K) |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 694.0 | 676.1 | 5.06 ms |
| main + this PR (commits 1-18) | 709.7 (+2.3%) | 694.1 (+2.7%) | 4.95 ms |
| main + megakernel plugin (sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega#18, default slots) | 762.2 (+9.8%) | 717.4 (+6.1%) | 4.57 ms |
| main + this PR (commits 1-18) + plugin (#18, 42 slots) | 952.0 (+37.2%) | 902.2 (+33.4%) | 3.66 ms |
| main + this PR (all 20 commits) + plugin (#18, 42 slots) | 995.7 (+43.5%) | 972.8 (+43.9%) | 3.54 ms |

Rows with this PR were measured with the changes listed above enabled, including `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE=1` and `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH=1` (on by default at measurement time). With the plugin held fixed, this PR adds +30.6% P50 / +35.6% P90 (rows 3 and 5). Rows 4 and 5 also enable three opt-in plugin slots. Without the plugin, the host work this PR removes is hidden behind the longer GPU step, so the PR alone moves little. Rows 1-3 repeat on a second cluster within 0.3% at P50.

Known interaction: with `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1` and `NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1` set in the environment, the deferred context-KV commit (`SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV`) adds a 45-105 ms stall before the last streamed token of requests above 256K tokens (87 / 209 such requests in one AgentX run). The stall grows with context length. With both NCCL variables at 0, no request stalls (0 / 209) and P90 rises 4.5%. The table above was measured without these variables.

### Reproduce

**Code and setup.** One GB300 node (4 GPUs), image `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261020-ab580b2e`, model `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` (revision `df42c109f1d`). Every tree is on `main` at `f0b65907227` with #45421 reverted (`git revert 7d9bc104932`): under `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN` that commit skips the accept sampling on CUDA.

| tree | rows |
|---|---|
| `f0b65907227` + the revert | Speed 1 and 3 |
| commits 1-18 on the same base (YAMY1234/sglang `98891329ced`) | Speed 2 and 4 |
| all 20 commits on the same base (YAMY1234/sglang `227d2a4934e`) | Speed 5, Accuracy |

The current head carries the same commits on a newer main plus review fixes. On it, also set `SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE=1` and `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH=1` (commits 3 and 7 had no switch when measured). Plugin for Speed 3-5 and Accuracy: sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega `547bf4486e9`, installed over the image's copy with `pip install --no-deps -e .`; it stays inactive without `--enable-nvidia-megakernel`.

**Server (Speed Tests).**

```bash
# all rows
export SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=rng,-dspark-accept-sample
export SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE=1 SGLANG_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE_LAYOUT=per_rank
export SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL=1
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.51 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token
export SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1 SGLANG_DSV41_REASONING_EFFORT=high SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900
# rows 2, 4 and 5: this PR's switches
export SGLANG_DSPARK_FUSED_ACCEPT_TAIL=1 SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_PREPARE_INPUTS_ONCE=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_MID_FOLD=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_POST_FOLD=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_DRAFT_PREP_FORK=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_ONE_LAUNCH_COMMIT_STAGE=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SKIP_PREFILLED_INPUTS=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SIM_DRAW_AHEAD=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_VERIFY_METADATA_GLUE=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_METADATA_EARLY=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_POST_FORWARD_CUDA_GRAPH=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_SKIP_GLUED_REPLAY_VIEW=1
# row 5 also
export SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION=1 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH=1
# rows 4 and 5: the plugin's 39 default slots + target_lm_head, hop_b_quad_trigger, lm_head_pinned_tactic
export SGLANG_NVIDIA_MEGAKERNEL_SLOTS=hop_a,moe,gate,attn,embed,two_shot,markov,draft_lm_head,aux_mean_stats,gate_wide,shared_ll,hop_a_batch2,engram,attn_qkv_a,attn_qkv_a_bf16,index_q_mxfp8_in,attn_indexer,hc_prenorm,hop_b,hop_b_wide,early_trigger,hop_b_start_trigger,draft,draft_moe,draft_gate,draft_tail,draft_post,draft_seam,draft_attn,draft_qfront,draft_wo_a,draft_swapab,draft_qkv_a,draft_prenorm,draft_qkv_a_ll,draft_wo_b_ll,sched_ahead,req_pos_once,kv_before_wait,target_lm_head,hop_b_quad_trigger,lm_head_pinned_tactic

Decode step p50 (> 256K) comes from TP0's `Decode batch` lines with one running request: accept length / gen throughput, lines above 262,144 tokens.

**Accuracy Tests.** Tree `227d2a4934e`, the plugin with the 42 slots above, real acceptance (no `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_*`), the server args above with `--max-running-requests 256`. +   probability tensors;

+   logits: accept iff ``log p(x) > log u + log q(x)``, i.e. ``u * q < p`` as before;
+3. a block-parallel Gumbel-max resample of the rejected row's residual
+   ``max(p - q, 0)`` (or of ``p`` at the bonus row), reduced by a one-program insert.
+

+functions of (server key, a device step counter, row, token). Every TP rank holds the
+same key, counter and logits, so ranks agree without a broadcast, and a CUDA graph
+replay advances the counter like an eager call. Distributions are those of the classic

+    counter: torch.Tensor

+    return (int(random_seed) ^ _REJECTION_NOISE_DOMAIN) & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

+"""The deferred context-KV commit's staging in one launch: the verify rows' write
+locations, positions and (with a ring) state slots, and the gated commit lengths
+with zeros past the staged requests."""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _stage_commit_kernel(
+    loc_src_ptr,
+    loc_dst_ptr,
+    pos_src_ptr,
+    pos_dst_ptr,
+    slot_src_ptr,
+    slot_dst_ptr,
+    lens_src_ptr,
+    lens_dst_ptr,
+    rows,
+    bs,
+    max_bs,
+    HAS_SLOT: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    LENS_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    r = tl.arange(0, ROWS_BLOCK)
+    m = r < rows
+    tl.store(loc_dst_ptr + r, tl.load(loc_src_ptr + r, mask=m), mask=m)
+    tl.store(pos_dst_ptr + r, tl.load(pos_src_ptr + r, mask=m), mask=m)
+    if HAS_SLOT:
+        tl.store(slot_dst_ptr + r, tl.load(slot_src_ptr + r, mask=m), mask=m)
+    q = tl.arange(0, LENS_BLOCK)
+    lens = tl.load(lens_src_ptr + q, mask=q < bs, other=0)
+    tl.store(lens_dst_ptr + q, lens, mask=q < max_bs)
+
+
+def stage_commit(
+    *,
+    cache_loc_dst: torch.Tensor,
+    positions_dst: torch.Tensor,
+    commit_lens_dst: torch.Tensor,
+    state_slot_dst: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    cache_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    commit_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    state_slot: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    rows: int,
+) -> None:
+    """``cache_loc_dst[:rows] = cache_loc[:rows]``, likewise positions / state slots,
+    ``commit_lens_dst[:bs] = commit_lens`` and ``commit_lens_dst[bs:] = 0``."""
+    assert cache_loc.is_contiguous() and positions.is_contiguous()
+    assert commit_lens.is_contiguous()
+    assert (state_slot is None) == (state_slot_dst is None)
+    bs, max_bs = commit_lens.shape[0], commit_lens_dst.shape[0]
+    _stage_commit_kernel[(1,)](
+        cache_loc,
+        cache_loc_dst,
+        positions,
+        positions_dst,
+        state_slot if state_slot is not None else cache_loc,
+        state_slot_dst if state_slot_dst is not None else cache_loc_dst,
+        commit_lens,
+        commit_lens_dst,
+        rows,
+        bs,
+        max_bs,
+        HAS_SLOT=state_slot is not None,
+        ROWS_BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(max(rows, 1)),
+        LENS_BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(max_bs),
+    )

+"""DSpark static greedy verify: the accept and its bookkeeping in one launch
+(SGLANG_DSPARK_FUSED_ACCEPT_TAIL), one program per request row.
+
+Per row, from the target's argmax ids: the leading draft matches and the bonus
+(AcceptGreedy; ``bonus_in`` replaces the bonus, ``bonus_parts`` replaces it with the
+in-graph simulated bonus's per-split maxima reduced here),
+the simulated correct length override (build_accept_outs), commit / new seq lens and
+a zero cap trim (FinalizeAcceptLens), the output tokens (BuildOutTokens), and the
+gated commit lengths the static epilogue's draft-KV commit reads. Every output equals
+the separate ops' bit for bit. With a simulated length and a supplied bonus the argmax ids
+are not read (``target_predict`` may be None).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dispatch import inputs_on_cuda
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.simulated_bonus import (
+    simulated_bonus_select_partials,
+)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _static_accept_tail_kernel(
+    candidates_ptr,
+    target_ptr,
+    seq_lens_ptr,
+    verify_lens_ptr,
+    gate_ptr,
+    sim_ptr,
+    bonus_in_ptr,
+    part_val_ptr,
+    part_idx_ptr,
+    correct_out_ptr,
+    bonus_out_ptr,
+    cap_trim_out_ptr,
+    commit_out_ptr,
+    new_seq_out_ptr,
+    out_tokens_ptr,
+    gated_out_ptr,
+    cand_stride,
+    out_tokens_stride,
+    vocab,
+    T: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_T: tl.constexpr,
+    NSPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_SIM: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_BONUS_IN: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_PARTS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEED_TARGET: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_GATED: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_T)
+    in_t = offs < T
+    gamma = T - 1
+    in_draft = offs < gamma
+    drafts = tl.load(
+        candidates_ptr + row * cand_stride + 1 + offs, mask=in_draft, other=-1
+    )
+    if NEED_TARGET:
+        targets = tl.load(target_ptr + row * T + offs, mask=in_draft, other=-2)
+        eq = (drafts == targets) & in_draft
+        num_correct = tl.min(tl.where(eq, BLOCK_T, offs), 0)
+    if HAS_PARTS:
+        # _simulated_bonus_row_select_kernel's reduction.
+        s = tl.arange(0, NSPLIT)
+        val = tl.load(part_val_ptr + row * NSPLIT + s)
+        idx = tl.load(part_idx_ptr + row * NSPLIT + s)
+        top = tl.max(val, axis=0)
+        bonus = tl.min(tl.where(val == top, idx, vocab), axis=0).to(tl.int64)
+    elif HAS_BONUS_IN:
+        bonus = tl.load(bonus_in_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    else:
+        bonus = tl.load(target_ptr + row * T + num_correct).to(tl.int64)
+    if HAS_SIM:
+        correct = tl.load(sim_ptr).to(tl.int32)
+    else:
+        correct = num_correct.to(tl.int32)
+    commit = correct + 1
+    new_seq = tl.load(seq_lens_ptr + row) + commit
+    tl.store(correct_out_ptr + row, correct)
+    tl.store(bonus_out_ptr + row, bonus)
+    tl.store(cap_trim_out_ptr + row, 0)
+    tl.store(commit_out_ptr + row, commit)
+    tl.store(new_seq_out_ptr + row, new_seq)
+    token = tl.where(offs == correct, bonus, tl.where(in_draft, drafts.to(tl.int64), 0))
+    tl.store(out_tokens_ptr + row * out_tokens_stride + offs, token, mask=in_t)
+    if HAS_GATED:
+        verify_len = tl.load(verify_lens_ptr + row)
+        gate = tl.load(gate_ptr)
+        gated = tl.minimum(commit, verify_len.to(tl.int32)) * gate
+        tl.store(gated_out_ptr + row, gated)
+
+
+def static_accept_tail(
+    *,
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    target_predict: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    verify_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    correct_len_out: torch.Tensor,
+    bonus_out: torch.Tensor,
+    cap_trim_lens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    commit_lens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    new_seq_lens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    out_tokens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    simulated_correct_len: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    bonus_in: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    bonus_parts: Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, int]] = None,
+    gated_commit_lens_out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> None:
+    """``candidates`` [bs, T] (anchor + drafts), ``target_predict`` [bs * T] argmax ids,
+    ``bonus_parts`` (part_val [bs, NSPLIT], part_idx, vocab); outputs go to rows [:bs]."""
+    assert bonus_in is None or bonus_parts is None
+    assert target_predict is not None or (
+        simulated_correct_len is not None
+        and (bonus_in is not None or bonus_parts is not None)
+    )
+    fn = (
+        _static_accept_tail_triton
+        if inputs_on_cuda(candidates)
+        else static_accept_tail_torch
+    )
+    fn(
+        candidates=candidates,
+        target_predict=target_predict,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        verify_lens=verify_lens,
+        gate=gate,
+        correct_len_out=correct_len_out,
+        bonus_out=bonus_out,
+        cap_trim_lens_out=cap_trim_lens_out,
+        commit_lens_out=commit_lens_out,
+        new_seq_lens_out=new_seq_lens_out,
+        out_tokens_out=out_tokens_out,
+        simulated_correct_len=simulated_correct_len,
+        bonus_in=bonus_in,
+        bonus_parts=bonus_parts,
+        gated_commit_lens_out=gated_commit_lens_out,
+    )
+
+
+def _static_accept_tail_triton(**kw) -> None:
+    candidates = kw["candidates"]
+    bs, T = candidates.shape
+    assert candidates.stride(1) == 1 and kw["out_tokens_out"].stride(1) == 1
+    dummy = kw["seq_lens"]
+    sim, bonus_in, parts, gated = (
+        kw["simulated_correct_len"],
+        kw["bonus_in"],
+        kw["bonus_parts"],
+        kw["gated_commit_lens_out"],
+    )
+    target = kw["target_predict"]
+    _static_accept_tail_kernel[(bs,)](
+        candidates,
+        target if target is not None else dummy,
+        kw["seq_lens"],
+        kw["verify_lens"],
+        kw["gate"],
+        sim if sim is not None else dummy,
+        bonus_in if bonus_in is not None else dummy,
+        parts[0] if parts is not None else dummy,
+        parts[1] if parts is not None else dummy,
+        kw["correct_len_out"],
+        kw["bonus_out"],
+        kw["cap_trim_lens_out"],
+        kw["commit_lens_out"],
+        kw["new_seq_lens_out"],
+        kw["out_tokens_out"],
+        gated if gated is not None else dummy,
+        candidates.stride(0),
+        kw["out_tokens_out"].stride(0),
+        parts[2] if parts is not None else 0,
+        T=T,
+        BLOCK_T=triton.next_power_of_2(T),
+        NSPLIT=parts[0].shape[1] if parts is not None else 1,
+        HAS_SIM=sim is not None,
+        HAS_BONUS_IN=bonus_in is not None,
+        HAS_PARTS=parts is not None,
+        # The argmax ids only decide a length or bonus nothing else supplies.
+        NEED_TARGET=sim is None or (bonus_in is None and parts is None),
+        HAS_GATED=gated is not None,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+
+
+def static_accept_tail_torch(
+    *,
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    target_predict: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    verify_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    correct_len_out: torch.Tensor,
+    bonus_out: torch.Tensor,
+    cap_trim_lens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    commit_lens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    new_seq_lens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    out_tokens_out: torch.Tensor,
+    simulated_correct_len: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    bonus_in: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    bonus_parts: Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, int]] = None,
+    gated_commit_lens_out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Reference: the same outputs from per-row torch ops (CPU or GPU)."""
+    bs, T = candidates.shape
+    gamma = T - 1
+    if target_predict is not None:
+        target = target_predict.view(bs, T)
+        matches = (candidates[:, 1:] == target[:, :gamma]).to(torch.int32)
+        num_correct = matches.cumprod(dim=1).sum(dim=1).to(torch.int32)
+    rows = torch.arange(bs, device=candidates.device)
+    if bonus_parts is not None:
+        part_val, part_idx, vocab = bonus_parts
+        bonus = simulated_bonus_select_partials(
+            part_val=part_val[:bs], part_idx=part_idx[:bs], vocab=vocab
+        )
+    elif bonus_in is not None:
+        bonus = bonus_in[:bs].to(torch.int64)
+    else:
+        bonus = target[rows, num_correct.long()].to(torch.int64)
+    if simulated_correct_len is not None:
+        correct = simulated_correct_len.repeat(bs).to(torch.int32)
+    else:
+        correct = num_correct
+    commit = correct + 1
+    new_seq = seq_lens[:bs] + commit.to(seq_lens.dtype)
+    correct_len_out[:bs].copy_(correct)
+    bonus_out[:bs].copy_(bonus)
+    cap_trim_lens_out[:bs].zero_()
+    commit_lens_out[:bs].copy_(commit)
+    new_seq_lens_out[:bs].copy_(new_seq)
+    tokens = torch.zeros((bs, T), dtype=torch.int64, device=candidates.device)
+    tokens[:, :gamma] = candidates[:, 1:]
+    tokens.scatter_(1, correct.long()[:, None], bonus[:, None])
+    out_tokens_out[:bs].copy_(tokens)
+    if gated_commit_lens_out is not None:
+        gated = torch.minimum(commit, verify_lens[:bs].to(torch.int32)) * gate
+        gated_commit_lens_out[:bs].copy_(gated)

+"""Target-verify attention metadata staged during the draft forward
+(SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_METADATA_EARLY).
+
+The verify inputs the metadata reads (positions, write locations, seq lens and
+req pool indices) are final once the decode head has run. ``stage``, which the host
+issues right after it launches the draft graph, copies them into the verify graph's
+buffers and replays the runner's captured metadata glue graph on a side stream that
+waits only for the head, so the GPU runs it beside the draft; the verify replay
+orders itself after that stream (``take``). Issued after the draft launch, the stage
+replaces the fill and glue replay the host would otherwise run before the verify,
+instead of adding host time before the draft.
+
+Contract:
+
+- The side stream first waits for the head's event, recorded on the current stream
+  after the previous verify replay, which has therefore finished reading the buffers
+  it rewrites.
+- The staged slots are private to the verify runner (never shared through the
+  process-wide input-buffer pool), so the draft graph neither reads nor writes
+  them; the glue graph writes only the verify backend's metadata.
+- ``take`` accepts the staged work only for the same glue key and the very same
+  source views; otherwise the current stream still waits for the side stream and
+  the runner refills and re-runs the glue graph itself.
+- Every staged record ends in a wait (``take`` or ``discard``) on the current
+  stream before anyone else refills the buffers.

+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_buffer_registry import (
+    CudaGraphBufferRegistry,
+    same_tensor_view,
+)

+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class VerifyInputSources(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    # input_ids is not staged: the draft graph may write it in place (mid fold).
+    positions: torch.Tensor
+    out_cache_loc: torch.Tensor
+    req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+
+
+STAGED_SLOTS = frozenset(VerifyInputSources.__struct_fields__)
+
+
+class _StagedVerifyInputs(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    key: Any
+    sources: VerifyInputSources
+
+
+class EarlyVerifyMetadata:
+    def __init__(self, *, device, log_every: int) -> None:
+        self._stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device)
+        self._done = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self._staged: Optional[_StagedVerifyInputs] = None
+        self._log_every = log_every
+        self.staged_ct = 0
+        self.taken_ct = 0
+        self.rejected_ct = 0
+        # Per attention variant: [replays that took the staged metadata, replays].
+        self.variant_cts: Dict[Any, list] = {}
+
+    def stage(
+        self,
+        *,
+        glue: MetadataGlueGraph,
+        key,
+        registry: CudaGraphBufferRegistry,
+        sources: VerifyInputSources,
+        after: torch.cuda.Event,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.discard()
+        self._stream.wait_event(after)
+        slot_sources = msgspec.structs.asdict(sources)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self._stream):
+            registry.copy_slots(slot_sources)
+            glue.replay(key)
+            self._done.record()
+        for src in slot_sources.values():
+            src.record_stream(self._stream)
+        self._staged = _StagedVerifyInputs(key=key, sources=sources)
+        self.staged_ct += 1
+        if self.staged_ct == 1 or self.staged_ct % self._log_every == 0:
+            logger.debug(
+                "Target verify metadata staged on the side stream: %d staged, "
+                "%d taken, %d rejected.",
+                self.staged_ct,
+                self.taken_ct,
+                self.rejected_ct,
+            )
+
+    def take(self, *, key, forward_batch) -> bool:
+        """True when this replay's inputs are the staged ones: the fill skips
+        ``STAGED_SLOTS`` and the glue graph already ran for ``key``."""
+        staged = self._staged
+        if staged is None:
+            return False
+        self.discard()
+        src = staged.sources
+        matches = staged.key == key and all(
+            cur is not None and same_tensor_view(cur, staged_src)
+            for cur, staged_src in (
+                (forward_batch.positions, src.positions),
+                (forward_batch.out_cache_loc, src.out_cache_loc),
+                (forward_batch.req_pool_indices, src.req_pool_indices),
+                (forward_batch.seq_lens, src.seq_lens),
+            )
+        )
+        if matches:
+            self.taken_ct += 1
+        else:
+            self.rejected_ct += 1
+            if self.rejected_ct == 1:
+                logger.info(
+                    "Staged target verify metadata did not match the replay "
+                    "(key %s vs %s); refilling on the main stream.",
+                    staged.key,
+                    key,
+                )
+        return matches
+
+    def count_variant(self, variant, *, taken: bool) -> None:
+        cts = self.variant_cts.setdefault(variant, [0, 0])
+        cts[0] += taken
+        cts[1] += 1

+                "Target verify replays of attention variant %s with staged metadata: "
+                "%d of %d.",
+                variant,
+                cts[0],
+                cts[1],
+            )
+
+    def discard(self) -> None:
+        """Order the current stream after any staged side-stream work."""
+        if self._staged is not None:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(self._done)
+            self._staged = None

+"""The DSpark draft graph's in-graph metadata prep forked onto a side stream
+(SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_DRAFT_PREP_FORK): embedding and the first layer's
+pre-attention run meanwhile, and the first draft attention joins it before it
+stores KV or reads the attention metadata."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Callable, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+_pending_join: Optional[torch.cuda.Event] = None
+
+
+def fork_in_graph_metadata_prep(
+    *, stream: torch.cuda.Stream, done: torch.cuda.Event, prep: Callable[[], None]
+) -> None:
+    global _pending_join
+    assert _pending_join is None, "previous forked metadata prep was never joined"
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        prep()
+        done.record()
+    _pending_join = done
+
+
+def join_in_graph_metadata_prep() -> bool:
+    """Make the current stream wait for a pending forked prep; True if one was."""
+    global _pending_join
+    if _pending_join is None:
+        return False
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(_pending_join)
+    _pending_join = None
+    return True

+"""The draft context-KV commit of a static verify, split around the accept
+(SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV).
+
+The commit projects the committed rows' target hidden into each draft stage's KV
+(GEMMs, independent of the accept) and stores the committed rows (needs the accept's
+commit lengths). In a static verify graph the projection is forked onto a side stream
+at the target's logits processor (a forward pre-hook, which SGLang's forward and a
+megakernel's head both call), so it overlaps the LM head and the accept; the static
+epilogue joins it and stages the store's arguments (write locations, positions, gated
+commit lengths, ring slots). The next captured draft graph runs the stores on a side
+stream forked at its head (a capture head hook); the draft's first KV store joins
+them (``join``, from the draft attention backend's ``get_swa_out_cache_loc``, which
+SGLang's draft attention and a megakernel's both reach on the store's stream). Any
+other forward runs the stores eagerly first.
+
+Contract:
+
+- Every write disarms the staging (commit lengths 0), so a staging is written once.
+- A forward that may write or read draft KV (prefill, draft extend, an eager draft)
+  runs after the pending write; a draft graph whose rows miss staged ones is preceded
+  by an eager write of every staged row.
+- Nothing reads draft KV between the verify and the next draft forward.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.aux_hidden_states import pack_aux_hidden_states
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Draft forwards between two counter lines.
+_LOG_EVERY = 4096
+
+
+class DeferredContextCommit:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_bs: int,
+        stride: int,
+        device,
+        kv_injector,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.stride = stride
+        self._max_rows = max_bs * stride
+        self._device = device
+        self._kv_injector = kv_injector
+        # Per draft stage [max_rows, kv width], made at the first (warmup) projection.
+        self.kvs: Optional[List[torch.Tensor]] = None
+        rows = self._max_rows
+        self.cache_loc = torch.zeros((rows,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.positions = torch.zeros((rows,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        # 0 for every request past the staged ones: their rows are not written.
+        self.commit_lens = torch.zeros((max_bs,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.state_slot = torch.zeros((rows,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        # Host, set at the first staging: the injector writes a per-request SWA ring.
+        self._with_state_slot = False
+        # SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_ONE_LAUNCH_COMMIT_STAGE: stage() in one Triton launch.
+        self._one_launch_stage = (
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_ONE_LAUNCH_COMMIT_STAGE.get()
+            and torch.device(device).type == "cuda"
+        )
+        # Side streams and events, made at the first use.
+        self._proj_stream: Optional[torch.cuda.Stream] = None
+        self._proj_done: Optional[torch.cuda.Event] = None
+        self._store_stream: Optional[torch.cuda.Stream] = None
+        self._store_done: Optional[torch.cuda.Event] = None
+        # Host: requests a static verify staged since the last write (0: nothing pending).
+        self.staged_bs = 0
+        # Host: a forked projection the static epilogue has not joined yet.
+        self._proj_unjoined = False
+        # Host, capture only: forked stores the draft's first KV store has not joined yet.
+        self._fork_unjoined = False
+        # Draft graph batch sizes whose capture recorded the forked stores.
+        self._forked_bs: set[int] = set()
+        self.num_written_in_graph = 0
+        self.num_written_eagerly = 0
+        self._eager_reasons: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._draft_forwards = 0
+
+    @property
+    def pending(self) -> bool:
+        return self.staged_bs > 0
+
+    def _pool(self):
+        return self._kv_injector.draft_model_runner.token_to_kv_pool
+
+    # Verify side: the projection (forked at the logits processor) and the staging.
+
+    def logits_pre_hook(self, module, args, kwargs) -> None:
+        """Forward pre-hook on the target's logits processor: in a static verify
+        graph (capture or warmup), fork the projection of the DSpark hidden."""
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import get_is_capture_mode
+
+        metadata = args[3] if len(args) > 3 else kwargs.get("logits_metadata")
+        aux = args[4] if len(args) > 4 else kwargs.get("aux_hidden_states")
+        if (
+            aux is None
+            or not metadata.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or not get_is_capture_mode()
+        ):
+            return
+        if self._proj_stream is None:
+            self._proj_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self._device)
+            self._proj_done = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self._proj_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self._proj_stream), torch.inference_mode():
+            kvs = self._kv_injector.draft_model.project_commit_kv(
+                main_hidden=pack_aux_hidden_states(aux), pool=self._pool()
+            )
+            if self.kvs is None:
+                assert not _capturing(), "the commit KV buffers are made at a warmup"
+                self.kvs = [kv.new_zeros((self._max_rows, kv.shape[1])) for kv in kvs]
+            n = kvs[0].shape[0]
+            for buf, kv in zip(self.kvs, kvs):
+                buf[:n].copy_(kv)
+            self._proj_done.record()
+        self._proj_unjoined = True
+
+    def join_projection(self) -> bool:
+        """In the static epilogue: wait for this graph's projection; False if none ran."""
+        if not self._proj_unjoined:
+            return False
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(self._proj_done)
+        self._proj_unjoined = False
+        return True
+
+    def stage(
+        self,
+        *,
+        cache_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        commit_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        state_slot: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> None:
+        """Recorded in a static verify graph of ``commit_lens.shape[0]`` requests."""
+        bs = commit_lens.shape[0]
+        n = bs * self.stride
+        self._with_state_slot = state_slot is not None
+        if self._one_launch_stage:
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.stage_commit import stage_commit
+
+            stage_commit(
+                cache_loc_dst=self.cache_loc,
+                positions_dst=self.positions,
+                commit_lens_dst=self.commit_lens,
+                state_slot_dst=self.state_slot if state_slot is not None else None,
+                cache_loc=cache_loc,
+                positions=positions,
+                commit_lens=commit_lens,
+                state_slot=state_slot,
+                rows=n,
+            )
+            return
+        self.cache_loc[:n].copy_(cache_loc[:n])
+        self.positions[:n].copy_(positions[:n])
+        self.commit_lens[:bs].copy_(commit_lens)
+        self.commit_lens[bs:].zero_()
+        if state_slot is not None:
+            self.state_slot[:n].copy_(state_slot[:n])
+
+    def note_static_verify(self, live_bs: int) -> None:
+        """Host, after a static verify graph ran ``live_bs`` requests."""
+        self.staged_bs = live_bs
+
+    # Draft side: the gated stores.
+
+    def write(self, bs: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
+        """The staged stores over the first ``bs`` requests (default all), then a
+        disarm, on the current stream."""
+        if self.kvs is None:
+            return
+        bs = self.commit_lens.shape[0] if bs is None else bs
+        n = bs * self.stride
+        pool = self._pool()
+        cache_loc = self.cache_loc[:n]
+        positions = self.positions[:n]
+        swa_loc = self._kv_injector.committed_swa_loc(
+            pool=pool,
+            cache_loc=cache_loc,

+"""CUDA graphs of the temperature-sampling verify accept of static DSpark decode steps
+(SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH).
+
+The static verify graph folds only the greedy accept (DsparkVerifyEpilogue). On an
+all-sampled step the rest ran eagerly after the replay: the draft and target softmax,
+the rejection kernel, the bonus gather, the accept-site TP broadcast, the engram
+history commit, the future relay and the target-hidden KV commit. This module captures
+that region once per verify-graph batch size and replays it right after the verify
+graph.
+
+The region reads the verify graph's static inputs and outputs (``static_io``) and the
+draft sampler's static buffers, which hold this step's values after both replays, so a
+replay stages nothing. Its accept outputs land in the epilogue's static accept buffers,
+like the greedy fold. Per key the first step runs eagerly (it compiles kernels and warms
+allocations), the second captures, later steps replay. The uniform draws come from
+torch's default generator, whose graph-safe offsets make a replay draw what the eager
+accept draws at the same generator state; with block-wise rejection they come from the
+worker's one RejectionNoise, whose device step counter a replay advances like an eager
+call. The DSPARK_ACCEPT_SAMPLE broadcast stays in
+the region (pynccl inside the graph), so TP ranks agree as in the eager path. With the
+deferred context-KV commit, the verify graph already joined this step's projection, so
+the region stages the stores from it.
+
+The caller routes only all-sampled steps without top-k / top-p, logit adjustments,
+grammar or a simulated sampled bonus; everything else keeps the eager accept.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from collections.abc import Callable, Hashable
+from functools import partial
+from typing import Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.blockwise_rejection import RejectionNoise
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_draft import DraftBlockResult
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_verify import (
+    AcceptOuts,
+    DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+    StaticVerifyIO,
+    accept_draft_tokens,
+    build_accept_outs,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_tp_sync import SpecTpSync, SpecTpSyncSite
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class GraphSamplingInfo(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """The SamplingBatchInfo fields the sampling accept reads, for an all-sampled
+    batch without top-k / top-p."""
+
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor
+    is_all_greedy: bool = False
+    is_any_greedy: bool = False
+    need_top_k_sampling: bool = False
+    need_top_p_sampling: bool = False
+
+
+def sampling_accept_commit_lens(
+    io: StaticVerifyIO,
+    *,
+    verify_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    gated: bool,
+    draft_sampler,
+    epilogue: DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+    tp_sync: SpecTpSync,
+    fused_argmax: bool,
+    block_verification: bool,
+    rejection_noise: Optional[RejectionNoise],
+) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """The eager sampling accept and finalize into the epilogue's static buffers;
+    returns the gated commit lengths when ``gated``."""
+    bs, stride = io.candidates.shape
+    params = draft_sampler.params
+    draft_tokens = io.candidates[:, 1:]
+    draft_block = DraftBlockResult(
+        draft_tokens=draft_tokens,
+        corrected_logits=(
+            None if draft_sampler.greedy_draft else draft_sampler.step_logits[:bs]
+        ),
+        greedy_mask=params.greedy_mask[:bs],
+        temperatures=params.temperatures[:bs],
+        greedy_draft=draft_sampler.greedy_draft,
+    )
+    correct_len, bonus, cap_trim_lens = accept_draft_tokens(
+        candidates=io.candidates,
+        target_logits=io.logits,
+        draft_block=draft_block,
+        # params.temperatures is the batch's, clamped at 1e-5 (resolve_draft_params).
+        sampling_info=GraphSamplingInfo(temperatures=params.temperatures[:bs]),
+        draft_input=None,
+        gamma=stride - 1,
+        verify_num_draft_tokens=stride,
+        fused_argmax=fused_argmax,
+        block_verification=block_verification,
+        rejection_noise=rejection_noise,
+    )
+    commit_lens = build_accept_outs(
+        correct_len=correct_len,
+        bonus=bonus,
+        cap_trim_lens=cap_trim_lens,
+        prefix_lens=io.seq_lens[:bs],
+        draft_tokens=draft_tokens.contiguous(),
+        gamma=stride - 1,
+        verify_num_draft_tokens=stride,
+        tp_sync=tp_sync,
+        sync_site=SpecTpSyncSite.DSPARK_ACCEPT_SAMPLE,
+        simulated_correct_len=epilogue.simulated_correct_len,
+        target_logits=io.logits,
+        out=epilogue.read_accept(bs),
+        block_accept_lens_out=epilogue.read_block_accept_lens(bs),
+    ).commit_lens
+    if not gated:
+        return None
+    return torch.minimum(commit_lens, verify_lens.to(torch.int32)) * gate
+
+
+class DsparkSamplingAcceptGraph:
+    """Per-batch-size CUDA graphs of the sampling accept region of static verify."""
+
+    # One key per verify-graph batch size is expected; more means addresses move,
+    # and the further keys run eagerly. Arbitrary bound.
+    MAX_GRAPHS = 32
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        epilogue: DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+        resolve_draft_sampler: Callable[[], Optional[object]],
+        tp_sync: SpecTpSync,
+        fused_argmax: bool,
+        block_verification: bool,
+        device,
+        rejection_noise: Optional[RejectionNoise] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._epilogue = epilogue
+        self._resolve_draft_sampler = resolve_draft_sampler
+        self._tp_sync = tp_sync
+        self._fused_argmax = fused_argmax
+        self._block_verification = block_verification
+        self._rejection_noise = rejection_noise
+        # The region always commits; padded rows are gated by verify_lens.

+"""A deferred-finalize MXFP4 trtllm-gen MoE call above 32 rows must pass the same
+output shape as a finalized one: FlashInfer keys its tactic cache on that shape, so a
+mismatch silently runs the untuned default tactic. At <= 32 rows deferred calls keep
+the (M, 0) placeholder key on purpose (the default tactic measured faster there)."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+# The quantization package must load before the MoE runner (circular import otherwise).
+import sglang.srt.layers.quantization.mxfp4_flashinfer_trtllm_moe as mxfp4
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner import flashinfer_trtllm
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher import StandardDispatchOutput
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+HIDDEN, INTER, EXPERTS, TOP_K = 64, 32, 4, 2
+
+
+def _layer():
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        w13_weight=torch.zeros(EXPERTS, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN),
+        w2_weight=torch.zeros(EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTER),
+        w13_weight_scale_inv=torch.zeros(EXPERTS, 2 * INTER, 1),
+        w2_weight_scale_inv=torch.zeros(EXPERTS, HIDDEN, 1),
+        num_experts=EXPERTS,
+        num_local_experts=EXPERTS,
+        moe_ep_rank=0,
+        output1_scale_scalar=None,
+        output1_scale_gate_scalar=None,
+        output2_scale_scalar=None,
+    )
+    method = object.__new__(mxfp4.Mxfp4FlashinferTrtllmMoEMethod)
+    method.flashinfer_mxfp4_moe_precision = "bf16"
+    method._gemm1_clamp_limit_tensor = None
+    method._bypassed_routing_method = None
+    return method, layer
+
+
+class TestMxfp4AutotuneKey(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_deferred_calls_pass_the_finalized_output_shape_above_32_rows(self):
+        method, layer = _layer()
+        outputs = []
+
+        def moe_call(**kwargs):
+            # FlashInfer keys a missing output as its (M, 0) deferred placeholder.
+            out = kwargs["output"]
+            rows = kwargs["hidden_states"].shape[0]
+            outputs.append((rows, 0) if out is None else tuple(out.shape))
+            return (out,)
+
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE.override(True),
+            get_parallel().override(tp_group=None),
+            patch.object(
+                mxfp4, "trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe", moe_call, create=True
+            ),
+            patch.object(mxfp4, "use_symmetric_memory", return_value=nullcontext()),
+            patch.object(mxfp4, "is_allocation_symmetric", return_value=False),
+            patch.object(flashinfer_trtllm, "_make_deferred_finalize_output"),
+            patch.object(
+                flashinfer_trtllm, "trtllm_moe_enable_pdl", return_value=False
+            ),
+        ):
+            # Pins the 32 / 33 floor and both sides of the old 97-384 range.
+            for rows in (32, 33, 96, 385):
+                x = torch.zeros(rows, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                ids = torch.zeros(rows, TOP_K, dtype=torch.int32)
+                topk = StandardTopKOutput(torch.ones(rows, TOP_K), ids, x.new_empty(0))
+                dispatch = StandardDispatchOutput(x, None, topk)
+                for deferred in (False, True):
+                    with self.subTest(rows=rows, deferred=deferred):
+                        with flashinfer_trtllm.flashinfer_trtllm_deferred_finalize_context(
+                            deferred
+                        ):
+                            method.apply(layer, dispatch)
+                        width = 0 if deferred and rows <= 32 else HIDDEN
+                        self.assertEqual(outputs[-1], (rows, width))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+(the DSV4 backend, then taking the draft block's extend lengths from device
+constants), and the runner hands the graph the registry's out_cache_loc slot instead
+of the step's own tensor."""

+from unittest import mock

+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import decode_cuda_graph_runner as mod

+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _backend(**overrides):
+    backend = dsv4.DeepseekV4AttnBackend.__new__(dsv4.DeepseekV4AttnBackend)
+    fields = dict(
+        is_dspark_draft=True,
+        trtllm_attn=False,
+        online_c128_mtp=SimpleNamespace(enabled=lambda: False),
+        token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(request_window=None),
+        draft_metadata_glued=False,
+        _draft_extend_lens={},
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    for name, value in fields.items():
+        setattr(backend, name, value)
+    return backend
+
+
+def _parallel(cp=1):
+    return mock.patch.object(
+        dsv4, "get_parallel", return_value=SimpleNamespace(attn_cp_size=cp)
+    )
+
+
+class TestHostFreeDraftPrep(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_the_audited_setup_accepts_and_glues(self):
+        backend = _backend()
+        with _parallel():
+            self.assertEqual(backend.glue_draft_metadata(), "")
+        self.assertTrue(backend.draft_metadata_glued)
+
+    def test_every_other_setup_says_why(self):
+        cases = {
+            "not the DSpark draft runner": dict(is_dspark_draft=False),
+            "trtllm-gen attention": dict(trtllm_attn=True),
+            "online c128 MTP": dict(
+                online_c128_mtp=SimpleNamespace(enabled=lambda: True)
+            ),
+            "a request window": dict(
+                token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(request_window=object())
+            ),
+        }
+        for why, overrides in cases.items():
+            backend = _backend(**overrides)
+            with _parallel(), self.subTest(why=why):
+                self.assertEqual(backend.glue_draft_metadata(), why)
+                self.assertFalse(backend.draft_metadata_glued)
+        with _parallel(cp=2):
+            self.assertEqual(_backend().glue_draft_metadata(), "context parallelism")
+
+
+class TestDraftExtendLengths(CustomTestCase):
+    def _moving(self, backend):
+        moved = []
+
+        def move(values):
+            moved.append(list(values))
+            return torch.tensor(values, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+        backend._move_to_device = move
+        return moved
+
+    def test_glued_keeps_one_constant_per_batch_size(self):
+        backend = _backend(draft_metadata_glued=True)
+        moved = self._moving(backend)
+        first = backend._draft_block_extend_lens([6, 6])
+        self.assertIs(backend._draft_block_extend_lens([6, 6]), first)
+        backend._draft_block_extend_lens([6])
+        self.assertEqual(moved, [[6, 6], [6]])
+        self.assertEqual(first.tolist(), [6, 6])

+        backend = _backend(draft_metadata_glued=True)
+        self._moving(backend)

+            mock.patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            mock.patch("torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing", return_value=True),
+        ):

+graph staged on a side stream beside the draft graph (waiting only for the head), and
+the runner gating that keeps every other configuration and variant on the main path."""

+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import (
+    DeepseekV4AttnBackend,
+    _GraphBucket,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.graph_variants import (
+    DSV41_CANDIDATE_FILTERED,
+    DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED,
+    Dsv41CandidateGraphVariants,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_buffer_registry import (
+    CudaGraphBufferRegistry,
+    GraphSlot,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.decode_cuda_graph_runner import (
+    DecodeCudaGraphRunner,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.early_verify_metadata import (
+    STAGED_SLOTS,
+    EarlyVerifyMetadata,
+    VerifyInputSources,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils import capture_mode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci, register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=4, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+KEY = (2, "TARGET_VERIFY", "TARGET_VERIFY", DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED)
+HEAD = object()  # the head's event the side stream waits for
+
+
+def _registry(device) -> CudaGraphBufferRegistry:
+    registry = CudaGraphBufferRegistry(
+        device=torch.device(device), max_bs=4, max_num_tokens=12
+    )
+    for name in sorted(STAGED_SLOTS):
+        tokens = name in ("positions", "out_cache_loc")
+        registry.register_slot(
+            GraphSlot(
+                name,
+                (lambda bs, mt: (mt,)) if tokens else (lambda bs, mt: (bs,)),
+                torch.int64,
+                axis="tokens" if tokens else "bs",
+            )
+        )
+    return registry
+
+
+def _sources(step: int, device="cpu") -> dict:
+    return {
+        "positions": torch.arange(6, device=device) + step,
+        "out_cache_loc": torch.arange(6, device=device) + 100 + step,
+        "req_pool_indices": torch.tensor([3, 1], device=device),
+        "seq_lens": torch.tensor([10, 11], device=device) + step,
+    }
+
+
+def _variants(span=16):
+    return Dsv41CandidateGraphVariants(
+        graph_limits=((DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED, span),),
+        capture_labels=(DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED, DSV41_CANDIDATE_FILTERED),
+        verify_extra_tokens=3,
+    )
+
+
+def _staging_runner(calls, *, captured=lambda key: key[0] != 4):
+    runner = DecodeCudaGraphRunner.__new__(DecodeCudaGraphRunner)
+    runner._early_verify_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        stage=lambda **kw: calls.append(("stage", kw["key"], kw["after"])),
+        take=lambda **kw: calls.append(("take", kw["key"])) or True,
+        discard=lambda: calls.append(("discard", None)),
+    )
+    runner.capture_forward_mode = ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY
+    runner.capture_bs = [1, 2, 4]
+    runner.captured_req_width = 3
+    runner.buffer_registry = None
+    runner.attention_graph_variants = _variants()
+    runner._metadata_glue = SimpleNamespace(is_captured=captured)
+    return runner
+
+
+def test_runner_stages_only_captured_unpadded_early_variant_keys():
+    calls = []
+    runner = _staging_runner(calls)
+
+    def stage(bs, max_seq_len=10):
+        return runner.stage_verify_metadata_early(
+            seq_lens=torch.zeros(bs),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.zeros(bs),
+            out_cache_loc=torch.zeros(bs * 3),
+            positions=torch.zeros(bs * 3),
+            max_seq_len=max_seq_len,
+            after=HEAD,
+        )
+
+    assert not stage(3)  # padded to 4 at replay
+    assert not stage(4)  # glue graph not captured yet
+    assert not stage(2, max_seq_len=14)  # 14 + 3 > 16: the filtered variant
+    assert not stage(2, max_seq_len=None)  # unknown length: the filtered fallback
+    assert stage(2, max_seq_len=13)
+    key = runner._glue_key(
+        2, str(ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY), DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED
+    )
+    assert key[-1] == DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED
+    assert calls == [("discard", None)] * 4 + [("stage", key, HEAD)]

+def test_runner_takes_only_an_unpadded_captured_replay():

+    runner = _staging_runner(calls)
+    fb = SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY)
+    mode = str(ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY)
+
+    def take(*, raw_bs=2, bs=2, is_ragged=False):
+        key = runner._glue_key(bs, mode, DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED)

+        )

+    assert not take(raw_bs=1)
+    assert not take(is_ragged=True)
+    assert not take(raw_bs=4, bs=4)  # its glue graph is gone
+    assert take()
+    key = runner._glue_key(2, mode, DSV41_CANDIDATE_UNFILTERED)
+    assert calls == [("discard", None)] * 3 + [("take", key)]

+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="needs CUDA")
+def test_side_stream_work_is_visible_after_take():
+    """Real streams: what the side stream wrote is what the main stream reads after
+    ``take``, step after step, while the main stream is busy past the head event; a
+    batch whose tensors are not the staged ones (even with equal values) or another
+    key is refused, so the replay refills."""
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    registry = _registry(device)
+    out = torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    seq_lens_buf = registry.get_slot("seq_lens").buffer
+
+    class Glue:
+        def replay(self, key):
+            torch.mul(seq_lens_buf[:2], 2, out=out)
+
+    early = EarlyVerifyMetadata(device=device, log_every=1000)
+    busy = torch.randn(2048, 2048, device=device)
+    head = torch.cuda.Event()
+    for step in range(5):
+        sources = _sources(step, device=device)
+        head.record()
+        for _ in range(4):
+            busy = busy @ busy.T / 2048  # the "draft", after the head
+        early.stage(
+            glue=Glue(),
+            key=KEY,
+            registry=registry,
+            sources=VerifyInputSources(**sources),
+            after=head,
+        )
+        other = dict(sources, positions=sources["positions"].clone())
+        if step == 1:
+            assert not early.take(key=KEY, forward_batch=SimpleNamespace(**other))
+            continue
+        if step == 2:
+            key = (4, *KEY[1:])
+            assert not early.take(key=key, forward_batch=SimpleNamespace(**sources))
+            continue
+        assert early.take(key=KEY, forward_batch=SimpleNamespace(**sources))
+        assert (out + 0).tolist() == [2 * (10 + step), 2 * (11 + step)]
+        positions = registry.get_slot("positions").buffer[:6]
+        assert positions.tolist() == list(range(step, step + 6))
+
+
+# The DSv4 backend side: the captured early metadata is written in place.

+
+class _Core:
+    """Mirrors DSV4AttnMetadata.copy_: tensors copied in place, except
+    swa_out_cache_loc, which copy_ assigns."""
+
+    def __init__(self, page_table, swa_out_cache_loc):
+        self.page_table = page_table
+        self.swa_out_cache_loc = swa_out_cache_loc
+
+    def copy_(self, other):
+        self.page_table.copy_(other.page_table)
+        self.swa_out_cache_loc = other.swa_out_cache_loc
+
+
+class _Metadata:
+    def __init__(self, page_table):
+        # As the real full build: the SWA write locations are left to the in-graph op.
+        self.core_attn_metadata = _Core(page_table, None)
+
+    def copy_(self, other):
+        self.core_attn_metadata.copy_(other.core_attn_metadata)
+
+
+def _building_backend():
+    def build(*, raw_metadata, online_c128_state_slot_offset, graph_backed):
+        # In-graph semantics: no free-memory chunking of the indexer schedule.
+        assert graph_backed
+        return _Metadata(raw_metadata.clone())
+
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        builds_verify_metadata_early=True,
+        cuda_graph_metadata_of_bucket_and_bs={_GraphBucket.TARGET_VERIFY: {}},
+        _early_verify_metadata_ids=set(),
+        low_ratios=(1, 2),
+        make_forward_metadata_from_raw_verify=build,
+        online_c128_mtp=SimpleNamespace(state_slot_offset=lambda: 0),
+        token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(
+            request_window=None,
+            swa_req_ring_size=None,
+            translate_loc_from_full_to_swa=lambda loc: loc + 1000,
+        ),
+    )

+def test_every_capture_and_replay_writes_the_first_captured_early_object(monkeypatch):
+    """The install replaces the in-graph op that translates the step's write
+    locations; every later install writes them into the tensor the graph reads. The
+    filtered variant's Raw entry of the same key is never touched."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(

+    )
+    backend = _building_backend()

+    for step in range(3):

+            backend, ragged_layout=None
+        )

+            backend,
+            graph_key=2,
+            raw_metadata=torch.tensor([1, 2]) + step,
+            out_cache_loc=torch.tensor([5, 6]) + step,

+            swa = captured.core_attn_metadata.swa_out_cache_loc
+            assert swa.dtype == torch.int32 and swa.tolist() == [1005, 1006]
+    bucket = backend.cuda_graph_metadata_of_bucket_and_bs[_GraphBucket.TARGET_VERIFY]
+    assert bucket[(2, "early")] is captured and backend.forward_metadata is captured

+    assert backend._early_verify_metadata_ids == {id(captured)}
+    assert captured.core_attn_metadata.page_table.tolist() == [3, 4]
+    # The verify graphs read the captured write locations by address.
+    assert captured.core_attn_metadata.swa_out_cache_loc is swa
+    assert swa.tolist() == [1007, 1008]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
